decision.explanation: The provided documents contain two distinct, non-contradictory assertions regarding awards received by Knut Korsæth. Document 1 (D1S3, D1S19) explicitly states he received the 'Commander of the Order of St. Olav' from King Olav V. Document 2 (D2S2) explicitly states he was bestowed the 'Commander of the Legion of Honour' at the French Embassy. Both are valid answers supported by direct textual evidence in the source segments, representing separate honors from different nations.
